note: Alberta Parks recreation area campground in the forest near the Hangingstone River, 35 km south of Fort McMurray off Hwy 63: one long loop of treed sites with a playground and picnic shelter. Three sites (44, 57, 58) are only 20 ft. The nearest sani-dump is in Fort McMurray or at Gregoire Lake Provincial Park. --Claude
